anchors.anchor_tiller_grip: centre of the tiller loop grip (hand point), child of tiller_handle so it follows steer + pump arc

facing: +Z (fork tips point toward +Z; the operator pulls from the tiller at -Z)
hierarchy: pallet_jack > body > {wheel_load_L, wheel_load_R, tiller > {tiller_frame, tiller_handle, wheel_steer_L, wheel_steer_R}}

rig.steer: rotate tiller about local Y (+-90 deg); its origin is ON the steer axis at the steer-wheel axle centre (x=0, y=0.10, z=-0.32 glTF), so the handle and both steer wheels swing together
rig.handle: rotate tiller_handle about local X: 0 = 12 deg back (rest/towing); -60..+15 deg pumping arc
rig.spin: rotate wheel_* about local X; steer wheels r=0.10 m, load rollers r=0.04 m
rig.lift: translate body +Y 0..0.115 m (lowered 0.085 -> raised 0.200 m fork top) while keeping wheels on the floor (move the wheel nodes -Y by the same amount)

nodes.body: forks 1.15 x 0.54 m overall (two 0.16 m channels), heel, back plate; origin on the ground at the fork heel centre
nodes.tiller: Empty on the steer axis at axle height
nodes.tiller_frame: pump, turntable, wheel yoke (turns with steering)
nodes.tiller_handle: handle, origin at the hinge pin (0.62 m)
